## Round 2 onboarding clarifications

Dana, four operational decisions remain before we finalize household groupings, advisor dashboards, and billing/AUM treatment. Proposed defaults are shown in bold.

items.trigger: Omar Farouk is listed as Active but also carries a Deceased tag; Schwab account CU-5007 holds $1.66M.
items.evidence: The conflicting records do not establish whether the account is proceeding through estate transition or whether the Deceased tag is incorrect.
candidate_options: Option A: Mark the household Inactive during the estate transition and exclude the $1.66M from active billing and advisor AUM totals.
Option B: Keep the household Active and include the $1.66M in active AUM pending confirmation from the estate team.
items.proposed_default: **Option A — Mark the household Inactive and exclude the $1.66M from active AUM until estate documentation is confirmed.**
items.question_for_dana: Please confirm whether Omar Farouk’s household should be marked Inactive and excluded from active billing and advisor AUM while the estate transition is being documented.

items.trigger: Kenji Nakamura has both Nakamura Holdings LLC ($8.9M at Schwab) and an individual IRA, CU-5011 ($210,000 at Schwab).
items.evidence: An April 30, 2025 meeting note says Kenji was consulting his CPA on whether to combine the IRA with the business entity or keep them separate.
candidate_options: Option A: Include the personal IRA in the Nakamura Holdings LLC household for a combined $9.11M view, pending confirmation.
Option B: Create a separate personal household for Kenji Nakamura for the $210,000 IRA.
items.proposed_default: **Option A — Include the IRA in the Nakamura corporate household for a combined $9.11M view, tagged as pending confirmation.**
items.question_for_dana: Should Kenji Nakamura’s personal IRA (CU-5011, $210,000) be included in the Nakamura Holdings LLC household for a combined $9.11M view, or set up as a separate personal household?

items.trigger: Custodian feeds include funded accounts with no matching client or household record: Carlos Vasquez, CU-5010 at Schwab ($980,000), and Priyanka Mehta, CU-6025 at Schwab ($670,000).
items.evidence: Each account needs a confirmed client household before it can appear correctly on an advisor dashboard or be included in household reporting.
candidate_options: Option A: Create new client households for Carlos Vasquez and Priyanka Mehta under their own names; advisor assignments would be needed for each.
Option B: Link each account to an existing family or trust; please identify the appropriate household for each.
items.proposed_default: **Option B — Keep both accounts in the unassigned onboarding queue until you confirm whether to create new client records or attach them to existing families or trusts.**
items.question_for_dana: For Carlos Vasquez’s CU-5010 and Priyanka Mehta’s CU-6025, should we create new client households or attach the accounts to existing families or trusts? If they are new households, please provide the advisor assignment for each.

items.trigger: Maria Delgado’s Schwab account CU-5004 shows $1.24M as of December 31, 2024, and Oliver Ashford’s Fidelity account CU-6024 shows $1.45M as of September 30, 2024, rather than June 30, 2025.
items.evidence: Both clients remain active, and neither has been flagged as churned; the available custodian balances are older than the current quarter-end reporting date.
candidate_options: Option A: Keep both clients active on advisor dashboards using their last reported balances, clearly tagged as pending statement refresh.
Option B: Exclude both accounts from current AUM totals until updated June 30, 2025 custodian statements are received.
items.proposed_default: **Option A — Keep both clients active on the dashboards using their last reported balances, tagged as pending statement refresh, rather than understating client totals.**
items.question_for_dana: Please confirm whether we should keep Oliver Ashford and Maria Delgado active on the dashboards using their last reported balances while we wait for refreshed custodian statements.
